findings.note: Three consecutive sentences open with "There was...", "No resolution was...", and "The chair made..."—the first two share "There was/No resolution was" structure, and the third repeats "was" but with a different subject. Actually, the run is "There was an expectation...", "No resolution was arrived at.", "The chair made the observation..." which do not share the same first two or three words. However, "It was decided by the committee" opens the first and the fourth sentences (not consecutive). The three-sentence run is "It was decided by the committee that a decision would be made...", "Very few of the members had actually read it.", "Unfortunately, the meeting was conducted..." which do not share openings. This finding is withdrawn as it does not meet the criteria.
